items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: he got me and he got Vic, and when we got to Houston he got a good piano player

ctx.x: See, Toby Mitchell was organizing that band for Bespawn(?) and Hill. And then they was also inn Houston, waiting for him, because he had went to New Orleans to try to pick up some musicians. And I don't think he tried very hard as he probably could... I think he took the money and spent it all there. Anyway, he got me and he got Vic, and when we got to Houston he got a good piano player
